_comment: Events shown only on the Live Overview: not in events.csv, so not on the miniconf. Times are local to the conference time zone; an empty end shows 'TBD'. Never put Zoom links here (this repository is public): set them on the backend's admin page, 'Test meeting link'. "debugOnly": true shows the event on live-debug.html only (a test meeting with its own Zoom link); "end_date" lets an event span several days. "zoomDirect": true makes its Zoom button the meeting link without the passcode (the full link is in its Slack channel), instead of the miniconf's zoom.html.
